mechanism: Systemic corticosteroid absorption from ophthalmic prednisolone can antagonize the antihypertensive and renal protective effects of ACE inhibitors, while captopril may potentiate corticosteroid-induced hypokalemia.
action: Monitor blood pressure and serum potassium levels during concurrent use; counsel patient on signs of hypokalemia; consider alternative ophthalmic agent if clinically feasible.
